text:
Anya Kaur: Quick follow-up on compact controls and toast focus behavior after today's console review. Need a short decision so QA can unblock.
Luis Mendoza: TL;DR: keep visual icon 16px in compact rows, preserve 44px hit area, and use a `table--compact` class.
Claire O'Hara: Agreed. Also toasts: default ones should not steal keyboard focus when a modal or inline editor is open. Use aria-live polite and only focus actionable toasts.
Ravi Singh: Implementation idea: add `data-toast-trigger="keyboard"` & `data-toast-actionable` attributes. JS extends duration and toggles focus only for actionable + high priority.
Anya Kaur: Good. Token proposals: `--compact-icon-size: 16px`, `--icon-hit-area: 44px`, `--table-row-compact-gap: 6px`, `--toast-duration-default: 4000ms`, `--toast-duration-keyboard: 10000ms`.
Luis Mendoza: Small CSS snippet I'll push: `.icon-compact { width: 16px; height: 16px; } .icon-compact__hit { padding: calc((44px - 16px)/2); } .table--compact tr { --row-gap: 6px; }`
Claire O'Hara: Copy tweak: replace terse "Saved" toasts with a tiny context: "Row saved  changes applied". Add i18n key.
Ravi Singh: Accessibility checks: QA will enforce that icon-only buttons include aria-label and that toasts with focus use `aria-modal` patterns only when promoted. I'll add tests.
design-bot: Draft tokens file created: design/tokens/compact-and-toast.yml (preview).
Anya Kaur: Action items: Luis implement tokens + playground, Claire update copy & docs, Ravi add tests and guardrails. Aim to land in next patch. :white_check_mark:
